visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of tall rounded benefit tiles with a background photo, a title and a + button that reveals the benefit detail

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: optional image cell (tile background), then a cell with the tile title (heading) followed by optional detail content revealed by the + button; detail may be a single link to a /fragments/ page, which is loaded as a fragment

reuseGuidance: Use for product-page benefit highlights where each tile expands to detail. Use the blue option when some tiles have no photo and need a solid fill.
